components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink pill with lemon text; flips to lemon on hover. The default call to action.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Khám phá sản phẩm <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 18L18 6M9 6H18V15"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: Nunito, 'Be Vietnam Pro', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 19px; min-height: 52px; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 999px; border: 3px solid #151515; background: #151515; color: #ffd400; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.18s ease, color 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ffd400; color: #151515; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #151515; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px #ffd400; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Transparent pill with ink edge; secondary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { font-family: Nunito, 'Be Vietnam Pro', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 19px; min-height: 52px; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 999px; border: 3px solid #151515; background: transparent; color: #151515; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #ffd400; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #151515; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px #ffd400; }

components.name: Ask Bar
components.description: Pill field holding a text input and an ink submit button; lemon halo on focus.
components.css: .ds-ask-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 10px; font: 800 17px/1.3 Nunito, sans-serif; color: #151515; } .ds-ask { display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 8px; max-width: 640px; background: #ffffff; border: 3px solid #151515; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-ask:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px #ffd400; } .ds-ask input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; background: transparent; font: 400 18px 'Be Vietnam Pro', Arial, sans-serif; color: #151515; outline: none; } .ds-ask input::placeholder { color: #5f5a4c; } .ds-ask button { font: 900 19px Nunito, sans-serif; min-height: 52px; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 999px; border: 3px solid #151515; background: #151515; color: #ffd400; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ask button:hover { background: #ffd400; color: #151515; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Cream header with ink bottom edge; current page is a lemon pill with an inset ink ring.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav"><button aria-current="page">Trang chủ</button><button>Sản phẩm</button><button>Công nghệ</button><button>Về chúng tôi</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 18px 24px; background: #fff8d6; border-bottom: 3px solid #151515; } .ds-nav button { font: 800 17px Nunito, sans-serif; color: #151515; background: transparent; border: 0; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav button:hover { background: #f6edc2; } .ds-nav button[aria-current="page"] { background: #ffd400; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2.5px #151515; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #151515; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px #ffd400; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Paper pills with ink edge; selected inverts to ink with lemon text.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; } .ds-tabs button { min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 999px; border: 2.5px solid #151515; background: #ffffff; color: #151515; font: 800 17px Nunito, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs button:hover { background: #ffd400; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected="true"] { background: #151515; color: #ffd400; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #151515; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px #ffd400; }

components.name: Walk Slab
components.description: One outlined slab of full-width rows separated by joints; dome tile and lemon fill mark what is available now, rib tiles mark later directions.
components.html:
• Đọc & Nhận diện

    Đọc chữ, nhận diện tiền và màu sắc.

  • Kết nối

    Gọi điện, SOS, nhạc và AI.
components.css: .ds-walk { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; border: 3px solid #151515; border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; background: #ffffff; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', Arial, sans-serif; color: #151515; } .ds-walk li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 52px minmax(140px, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 1.4fr); align-items: center; gap: 16px 28px; padding: 22px 28px; } .ds-walk li + li { border-top: 2px solid rgb(21 21 21 / 18%); } .ds-walk li.is-now { background: #ffd400; } .ds-walk h3 { margin: 0; font: 900 24px/1.2 Nunito, sans-serif; } .ds-walk p { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; } .ds-tile { display: inline-block; width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 8px; background-color: #ffd400; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2.5px #151515; } .ds-dome { background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 36%, #fff3a8 0 1.5px, transparent 2.5px), radial-gradient(circle, #e3bb00 0 4.5px, #c9a500 5px, transparent 6px); background-size: 13px 13px; background-position: 1px 1px; } .ds-rib { background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 6px, #e3bb00 6px 11px, #c9a500 11px 12px, transparent 12px 14px); background-position: 4px 0; }

components.name: Guidance Strip Rail
components.description: Lemon strip with section stops: passed = rib tile, current = inked dome with glint, upcoming = plain dome.
components.css: .ds-strip { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 64px; padding: 14px 0; background: #ffd400; border: 3px solid #151515; } .ds-stop { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-stop span { width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 35%, #fff3a8 0 3px, transparent 4px), #e3bb00; box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 #c9a500, 0 0 0 2.5px #151515; transition: all 0.25s ease; } .ds-stop.is-passed span { width: 30px; height: 22px; border-radius: 5px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #e3bb00 0 5px, #ffd400 5px 9px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2.5px #151515; } .ds-stop.is-active span { width: 30px; height: 30px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 64% 34%, #fff8d6 0 4px, transparent 5px), #151515; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #ffd400, 0 0 0 6.5px #151515; } .ds-stop:hover span { transform: scale(1.12); } .ds-stop:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #151515; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Braille Cell
components.description: The logo's S cell (dots 2, 3, 4 raised; dot 4 is the pupil) as tactile domes on a lemon plate.
components.css: .ds-cell { --d: 64px; display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, var(--d)); grid-auto-rows: var(--d); gap: calc(var(--d) * 0.36); padding: calc(var(--d) * 0.4); background: #ffd400; border: 3px solid #151515; border-radius: 28px; } .ds-dot { place-self: center; width: 34%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 38% 34%, #fff3a8 0 8%, transparent 14%), #e3bb00; box-shadow: inset 0 -4px 0 #c9a500, 0 0 0 2.5px rgb(21 21 21 / 35%); } .ds-dot.up { width: 100%; background: #151515; box-shadow: 0 10px 18px rgb(21 21 21 / 28%); } .ds-dot.pupil { position: relative; width: 118%; } .ds-dot.pupil::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 18%; top: 16%; width: 26%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff8d6; }

narrative.overview:
The site is laid like the tactile paving at a Vietnamese crosswalk. A lemon guidance strip runs down the left edge of every page; the page itself is cream pavement with faint square joints at a 96px tile pitch; content sits on flush slabs edged with 3px ink outlines and separated by joints. The two tile textures carry meaning everywhere they appear: dome tiles say stop and look (the current thing, the thing available now), rib tiles say keep going (passed, in progress, future direction). Type is ink, heavy and round; nothing glows.

The world is built for low-vision readers first. Contrast is high by construction (ink on cream, ink on lemon, lemon on ink), body text is 18px, headings are 900-weight rounded sans, and emphasis is a highlighter stroke rather than italic or colour. Density is calm: one idea per slab, generous section padding, long rows instead of grids of small cards.

The signature is the logo's six-dot braille cell (letter S, dots 2, 3, 4; dot 4 is also the pupil), rendered as tactile domes on a lemon plate in the home opening, and the same dome/rib vocabulary scaled down into section-rail stops, step markers and row tiles. It rejects the dark, glowing "AI glasses" hero and the icon-card feature grid.
keyCharacteristics: Cream pavement ground with 1px joints at 96px tile pitch.
A fixed lemon guidance strip (64px; 14px on mobile) that doubles as the section rail.
Dome = stop and look; rib = keep going. Applied consistently to tiles, steps and rail stops.
Flush slabs with 3px ink outlines, divided by 2px joints, never floating cards.
Nunito 800/900 for every heading and control; Be Vietnam Pro 18px for reading.
Ink pill buttons with lemon text; monoline icons with round caps.

rules.name: The Signage Pair Rule
rules.body: Text is ink on cream, paper or lemon, or lemon/cream on ink. No other text pairing; no lemon text on light grounds.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Emphasis inside a heading is a highlighter band (58% to 92% of the line): lemon on cream and paper, paper on lemon slabs, plain lemon text with no band on ink slabs. Emphasis in body copy is weight 700, no band.

rules.name: The Relief-Only Rule
rules.body: lemon-deep, lemon-shade and dome-glint model tile relief and nothing else.

rules.name: The Upright Rule
rules.body: Nothing is italic, anywhere: em, blockquote, cite and quote classes are forced upright.

rules.name: The One Display Voice Rule
rules.body: h1 and h2 are always 900, h3 always 800, always Nunito, always ink (or lemon/cream on ink slabs).

rules.name: The Wordmark Rule
rules.body: "SeeVia" as a mark is never typeset; it is always the official hand-drawn wordmark from the logo files.

rules.name: The Flush Paving Rule
rules.body: Articles, figures, cards and panels in page content sit flush on the pavement with no shadow. Only overlays (drawer, assistant widget) cast shadows.

dos: Do set every heading in Nunito 900 (h3 800) and ink; keep body copy at 18px Be Vietnam Pro, 1.65 line height.
Do use dome tiles for "stop and look / available now" and rib tiles for "keep going / passed / later", and never swap them.
Do group related items as rows in one 3px-outlined slab separated by 2px joints.
Do emphasise heading words with the highlighter band: lemon on cream and paper, paper on lemon, lemon text on ink.
Do use the ink logo on cream, paper and lemon, and the lemon (or white) logo on ink; use the official SVG paths verbatim.
Do keep the 3px ink outline plus lemon halo focus ring on every interactive element, and 44px minimum targets.
Do draw icons and illustrations as monoline strokes with round caps and joins in currentColor.
donts: Don't place the lemon logo (or any lemon text) on white, cream or other light grounds.
Don't retype "SeeVia" in Nunito, Be Vietnam Pro or any other font; use the wordmark file.
Don't use italics anywhere, including quotes and emphasis.
Don't set headings in ink-soft or any colour other than ink (lemon and cream only on ink slabs).
Don't float content blocks with shadows; shadows belong only to the drawer and the assistant widget.
Don't build a dark, glowing "AI glasses" hero or an icon-card feature grid.
Don't use lemon-deep, lemon-shade or the dome glint as text or flat fill colours.
